# Independent audit: geometric-mean affine attainment and penalized properness

Audited in full:
`candidate 108870e8f9aac2e9`.
Also read its compactification dependency
`candidate f7c05b2c30c8cfcb` and the finite
arithmetic proof `candidate 9ae432ab1b731d70`.


extremal settings and exact derivative constraints. Neither supplies the
missing numerical payment inequality.

## 1. Compactification and the unpenalized parameter escape

The argument uses the original-depth restriction/minimal-base hypotheses,
not an unproved restriction inequality for a buffered functional. The
uniform positive fiber-mass and bounded-body representatives consequently
apply to any sufficiently low buffered or penalized sequence, since both
objectives dominate original depth. Positive limits retain the stated
strict proper-minor quotas.

Arithmetic normalization h=ell/P gives bounded affine coefficients because
all volume weights stay uniformly positive. If its limiting affine function
is positive everywhere, geometric renormalization stays finite and positive.
Otherwise its zeros form a nonempty proper face; a vanishing value with
weight bounded below makes the geometric denominator tend to zero, so ell
diverges at EVERY sampled base outside that face. No conclusion about a
moving lattice point is needed.

The full-buffer/base-depth argument has the correct direction: when its
physical continuous shift is at least 2R, every fiber with nonnegative
base margin is wholly captured in every nonvertical cap. Pure-base caps
remain in the infimum. Thus its value equals the closed base depth exactly.
Covariance has a uniform positive smallest eigenvalue on the compact
positive-body family. Applying the audited face-quota theorem at the limit
then contradicts the bad sublevel for fixed epsilon. Finite base depth is
continuous in the finitely many weights. This proves the positive-parameter
sublevel compactness claimed for each fixed epsilon, without a uniform
ell bound as epsilon decreases.

## 2. Penalty compactness and uniform properness

The objective beta_epsilon+epsilon^2(P-1) is affine invariant and at least
the original infimum because weighted AM--GM gives P>=1. The original
minimizer tested with ell=1 has zero penalty and excess at most epsilon LR.
Thus a sufficiently late minimizing sequence belongs to the same compact
original bad sublevel.

For fixed epsilon its bounded penalty bounds P, hence ell_z<=P/w_z.
Geometric mean one and a common upper bound A0 then give precisely
ell_z>=A0^(-(1-w_z)/w_z). Uniform positive weights make this a common
positive lower bound. Marked-energy and covariance continuity therefore
prove attainment in the positive parameter domain.

At an attained penalized minimum, subtracting beta_epsilon>=beta_0^* from
the reference inequality gives P<=1+LR/epsilon, with no hidden mass factor
in the M=1 frame. Since ell_z E_z/M<=ell_z V_z/M<=P and Gamma(u)<=R for
Euclidean unit u, the physical displacement is at most

    Delta_epsilon=epsilon R(1+LR/epsilon)^(1/(d+1)).

Its (d+1)-st power is R^(d+1)[epsilon^(d+1)+LR epsilon^d], so it tends to
zero in every d>=1. The slab error is L Delta_epsilon uniformly in the
source, normal, and unbounded base tilt.

The largest-fiber centroid gives actual raw depth c=Gamma_d/m in the
M=1 frame. A buffered maximizer therefore has original depth at least
c-L Delta. Original depth is L-Lipschitz within its fiber and zero on its
boundary, so its boundary distance is at least (c-L Delta)/L. The explicit
condition L Delta<c/4 yields distance greater than 3c/(4L) and physical
shift less than c/(4L). Every shifted own plane is consequently proper.
The argument controls all maximizing marks, not only a selected reference
source. Supporting other-fiber traces remain governed by the nonlinear
inverse theorem, as the source states.

## 3. Exact derivative audit

For V_z'=-D_z and M'=-D, differentiating geometric normalization gives

    s=ell_z'/ell_z=sum_z D_z log ell_z/M

when the unnormalized affine shape is fixed. The old logarithmic mean
zero is needed here and is used correctly. The own fixed-mark derivative
is therefore f'/f=(-C/E+D/M+s)/(d+1).

Differentiating P=sum w ell gives exactly

    P'=sum_z D_z[P(1+log ell_z)-ell_z]/M.

It can have either sign. At a common continuous affine volume scaling,
D_z is proportional to V_z and geometric normalization makes s=0, as
required by invariance.

For a fixed-body affine parameter perturbation phi, the normalization
correction is ell'=phi-ell A_phi with A_phi=sum w phi/ell. Hence
P'=sum w phi-P A_phi. The regular-singleton contact response is
q_i'=delta_i(phi_i/ell_i-A_phi)/(d+1). Taking a finite nonnegative
combination of q_i'/M+epsilon^2 P', and multiplying by (d+1)M, gives
exactly displayed equation (16), including its factor M. The separation
uses actual upper covers: absence of a direction decreasing every cover
is enough, without claiming differentiability of the global maximum.

The stated barycenter condition for the unpenalized case follows after
also testing the affine constant phi=1 and normalizing the resulting
positive measures. Its target weights are w_z/ell_z, not the unweighted
volume barycenter. The penalty adds the separate positive volume-weight
measure shown in (16). No relative-smallness of that added term follows
merely from its absolute epsilon^2 coefficient, and the source explicitly
retains that limitation.

## 4. Independent exact verification and scope

`supporting computation verify_geometric_affine_buffer_penalty_audit_defect_transport.py` passes
**2,606 exact symbolic/rational checks**. It independently differentiates
the geometric constraint, both P formulas, the penalized finite separation
identity, affine-scale neutrality, and the exact small-buffer power bound.

The compact original bad-family and minimal-base hypotheses remain
conditional inputs. The penalty is not omitted when comparing competitors.
No assertion that these necessary conditions already force Gamma_d/k is
made or supported by this audit.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
